rules.statement: A Fiscal's transfer after the death of a purchaser, in favor of the purchaser’s heirs or legal representatives, is not valid to convey title.
rules.supporting_quote: "This appeal raises the question whether a Fiscal's transfer executed after the death of the purchaser, in favour of the purchaser, 'his heirs, executors, administrators, and assigns,' passes a valid title to the administrator of the purchaser's estate."
